title: HPayroll
tagline: Hedera Payroll turns salary into financial wellness with financial education.
description:
Our project aims to do the following:

Enables employers to offer a unique benefit that helps employees diversify their finances and investments.

Provides financial education to empower employees to make smarter money decisions.

Unlocks investment opportunities built on the existing trust between employer and employee.

Allow payment agreements between employers and employees to be registered in the Hedera blockchain so they become transparent and auditable by all parties

The PDF with the Pitch Deck is here https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ymPOv4PGDokaYyc-2QADvEA4NyTLLyHe/view?usp=sharing
how_its_made:
Two main components:

1: Get price feeds from Oracle-Pyth so that employees can get financial information to allow them to select one or more and use their money on them

2: Put on chain the future payments that the employee and the employer agreed upon. So that the information is transparent and visible to all parties involved. These transactions are created with the Hedera SDK (java) using the feature "create scheduled transaction"
